_note: mobsfscan is an ordinary lane entry (cross-platform, one pass over the source). The Apple signing tools need per-artifact discovery AND per-artifact attribution, which this schema cannot express, so they go through the bundled macscan.py — one entry per tool, so each keeps its own probe, skip reason and sentinel line. Doing the discovery in Python also removes macos-runner's `done < <(cat ...)` process substitution, which the Bash tool refuses outright whatever is granted, and which therefore never ran.

tools.name: mobsfscan
tools._note: Identical to the android lane's entry — same tool, same shapes. `--json` writes to stdout; `--output -` does NOT, it creates a file literally named `-` and leaves stdout empty.

tools._note: rc 3 covers both 'not a macOS host' and 'no artifact of this tool's shape under the target'; the wrapper distinguishes them on stderr and the runner keeps `requires-macos-host` in its vocabulary for the host case.
